note: Labelled projection. Omitted numerical payloads and listed bulk report collections remain outside Git; configuration metadata is retained.

report.interpretation: Forward and parameter-gradient parity at these shapes can localize a backend discrepancy. Passing cannot certify all past updates; failing does not alone quantify historical model-quality damage.

off.D_state_policy: Fixed saved discriminator, no D update; not an exact D-then-G training step
limits: Representative fixed checkpoint/batches only; does not certify every historical shape or call order.
cuDNN off is a comparison backend, not assumed exact arithmetic.
1e-5 absolute-plus-relative is an anomaly screen; raw norms and errors are authoritative.
D feature evidence retains first eight rows at every layer; all32 output logits and all parameter gradients are retained.
